fields.label: Intro paragraph
fields.value: When a tooth is cracked, heavily filled or weakened after root canal therapy, a crown can help protect it and restore its function. Traditionally, crowns required two appointments, a temporary crown and a wait of a week or more while a laboratory made your restoration. With CEREC, many crowns can be designed, made and fitted at Precision Dental in a single visit.

fields.label: Intro paragraph
fields.value: We use CEREC because it offers a precise, efficient way to restore teeth while reducing the number of appointments many patients need.

fields.label: Heading
fields.value: What Is CEREC?

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: CEREC is a digital system that allows ceramic restorations to be created in the dental practice. Instead of traditional impression putty, a 3D intra-oral scanner captures a detailed digital model of your tooth. Your crown is then designed on screen and milled from a solid block of high-strength ceramic in our practice.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: CEREC can be used to make crowns, inlays, onlays and some veneers. Because the process takes place on site, your dentist can oversee each step, from design to final fit.

fields.label: Heading
fields.value: Is a CEREC Crown Right for You?

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: A CEREC restoration may be suitable if you have:

fields.label: List item
fields.value: A cracked or broken tooth

fields.label: List item
fields.value: A tooth with a large, failing filling

fields.label: List item
fields.value: A tooth that needs protection after root canal therapy

fields.label: List item
fields.value: A worn or weakened back tooth

fields.label: List item
fields.value: An old crown that needs replacement

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Not every situation suits a same-day restoration. Some complex cases, such as long-span bridges, certain front teeth or restorations requiring specialised shading, may be better made by a dental laboratory. For smaller areas of damage, a white filling may be enough. We will explain the most suitable option for your tooth.

fields.label: Heading
fields.value: What Happens at Your Appointment

fields.label: Subheading
fields.value: Assessment

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: We examine the tooth, take digital X-rays and check your bite. If a crown is recommended, we explain why, outline alternatives and provide a quote.

fields.label: Subheading
fields.value: Preparation and Scanning

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Local anaesthetic is used to keep you comfortable. Any decay or old filling material is removed, and the tooth is shaped to make room for the crown. We then scan the tooth with our 3D intra-oral scanner.

fields.label: Subheading
fields.value: Design and Milling

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Your crown is designed digitally to fit your tooth and bite. It is then milled from ceramic in our practice while you relax, which usually takes a short time.

fields.label: Subheading
fields.value: Fitting

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: We try in the crown, check the fit and bite, then bond it into place and polish it. In many cases, you leave with your final crown on the same day.

fields.label: Heading
fields.value: Aftercare and Ongoing Care

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Your tooth and gums may feel tender for a day or two. Wait until the anaesthetic has worn off before eating. Brush and floss around your crown as you would your natural teeth, and attend regular check-ups and cleans. A crown does not prevent decay at the edge where it meets the tooth, so daily cleaning remains important. If you grind your teeth, a night splint may be recommended.

sections.label: Why Choose Precision Dental for CEREC Crowns

fields.label: Heading
fields.value: Why Choose Precision Dental for CEREC Crowns

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Our in-house CEREC system and 3D scanner allow us to design and create many restorations on site, which can mean fewer appointments and no temporary crown. Dr Billy Choi has used digital dentistry for many years and takes great care to achieve a precise fit and a comfortable bite.

sections.label: Fees, Health Funds and Payment Options

fields.label: Heading
fields.value: Fees, Health Funds and Payment Options

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: The cost of your treatment depends on your individual needs. After your examination, we talk you through your options and the expected fees before any treatment begins. We accept most major health funds, process claims on the spot through HICAPS and are a preferred provider for {{site:preferredFunds}}. Interest-free payment plans are available through DentiCare for eligible patients, subject to terms and conditions. You can learn more on our Prices and Payment Options page.

fields.label: Small label
fields.value: FAQ

fields.label: Heading
fields.value: Frequently Asked Questions

fields.label: Question
fields.value: How long does a CEREC appointment take?

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: A same-day crown appointment usually takes a few hours, including preparation, design, milling and fitting. We will give you an estimate before your visit.

fields.label: Question
fields.value: Are CEREC crowns as strong as laboratory crowns?

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: CEREC crowns are milled from high-strength dental ceramics designed for everyday biting forces. The most suitable material depends on the tooth, your bite and your habits.

fields.label: Question
fields.value: Will I need a temporary crown?

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: In most same-day cases, no temporary crown is needed, because your final crown is fitted at the same visit.

fields.label: Question
fields.value: How long do CEREC crowns last?

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Like all dental restorations, the lifespan of a crown varies. Oral hygiene, grinding habits and regular maintenance all play a role.

fields.label: Question
fields.value: Can CEREC be used for front teeth?

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Sometimes. For certain front teeth, a laboratory-made restoration may allow more detailed colour layering. We will advise which approach suits you.

fields.label: Question
fields.value: Is a CEREC crown covered by my health fund?

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Many extras policies with major dental cover provide rebates for crowns. We process claims on the spot through HICAPS and can provide item numbers so you can check with your fund.
